_README.purpose: Summon talents that spawn a token on the scene. When a listed talent is used, register-skills.js creates an `adversary` actor with stats scaled to the caster (HP/defenses/attack baked at summon time via DerivedValueField overrides) and drops a token near the caster. Keyed by exact talent name.

fields.name: Display name of the summoned creature (the actor is named '<name> (<caster>)').
fields.img: Token/portrait image path (must exist under the Foundry data or system icons).
fields.hpFormula: Roll expression for the summon's max HP, resolved against the CASTER. e.g. '(@tier)d(2 * @skills.green.rank + 2)'.
fields.defensePenalty: Subtracted from each of the caster's defenses (phy/cog/spi) to set the summon's, via override. e.g. 3 = 'defenses equal to yours minus 3'.
fields.conditionImmunities: Array of condition ids the summon is immune to (e.g. frightened, compelled, disoriented).
fields.attack: { name, damageFormula (resolved against caster, baked to literal dice at summon time), damageType, range:'melee'|'ranged' }.
fields.actsAfterCaster: true = add to the combat tracker on the caster's initiative.

_README.status: DATA SCAFFOLD — the summon runtime (useItem hook → adversary creation + token drop) is the next build (L). This file is the data contract for it.

Risen Servant.name: Risen Servant
Risen Servant.note: Death (Morrath). Costs 1 Investiture + a Harvested Remain (resource tracked separately). Defenses = caster − 3; one melee attack/turn; acts on the caster's initiative.

Forge Construct.name: Combat Construct
Forge Construct.note: Civilization (Kethane). HP = [Tier][Die] + Tier x 2; deflect 1; defenses = caster − 2; one melee attack/turn; acts on the caster's initiative. Sustain ONE. Tempered Edge (+[Tier][Die] energy, ignore deflect) and Siege Form (ranged [Tier][Die] + Strength energy) are separate talents applied manually to the Construct's attack.
